content:
Yahoo Weather for iPhone and iPad was recently updated with a major overhaul that focuses on new features and an overall redesign.

The updated app introduces enhanced radar and interactive maps, alongside minute-by-minute precipitation forecasts to help you stay ahead of sudden downpours.

In addition to standard temperature tracking, the new Yahoo Weather app now includes detailed insights for air quality, pollen levels, and moon phases.

One of the most notable additions is a new daily weather narrative. It’s designed to provide users with a clear, contextual summary of what to expect from the day’s forecast rather than just a simple temperature reading.

The all-new Yahoo Weather app is available now on the App Store as a free update.
